entry: The owner: "Also, Fable recommended this: Use the strongest models for sign-in, playback and the video player. Cheaper models can handle other work, with review. I read that as Opus 5.5" and "Let's make that a rule in our CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md." For sign-in, playback and video-player work, Check, Build, Fix and the adversarial review run on Opus 5.5. The lead's reading, told to the owner: cheaper models may write the first checks (Opus checks them) and do helper work with review.
